entities.summary: Charles Chao or Guowei Chao has served as the chairman of the board of directors since the inception of Weibo Corporation. He has served as the chairman of the board of directors of Weibo's parent company, Sina, since August 2012, and has been Sina's Chief Executive Officer since May 2006. He served as Sina's president from September 2005 to February 2013, Chief Financial Officer from February 2001 to May 2006, and Co-Chief Operating Officer from July 2004 to September 2005. He also served as Sina's Executive Vice President from April 2002 to June 2003 and Vice President, Finance from September 1999 to January 2001.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As CEO of Sina from May 2006 to September 2013, Charles Chao played a crucial role in shaping China's internet landscape. His leadership helped Weibo Corporation become one of the largest social media platforms in China.
